# `extraction/output/`

Per-target normalized graph evidence and coverage reports.

## Committed artifacts (Phase 1)

```
extraction/output/
  manifest.json                          # top-level run manifest (status=phase1_real_extraction)
  signal/
    graph.json                           # AegisGraph evidence records for Signal-Android
    coverage.json                        # tool_run_status, path_class_coverage, etc.
  element-x/
    graph.json
    coverage.json
```

## Gitignored intermediates (regenerated by `make extract`)

```
extraction/output/<target>/raw/                       # SARIF, semgrep JSON, large
extraction/output/<target>/codeql-db/                 # CodeQL DB, multi-GB
extraction/output/<target>/manifest-analysis.json     # input to manifest_to_graph.py
extraction/output/<target>/mobsf-results.json         # input to mobsf_to_graph.py
```

The intermediates are private-only — they may carry filesystem paths from
the temp clone of target source. Only the normalized
`graph.json`/`coverage.json` artifacts are committed.

## Reproducibility

Running `make extract` twice (in a clean tmpdir or in this worktree) MUST
produce byte-identical `graph.json`, `coverage.json`, and `manifest.json`
modulo the static `generated_at` constant. This is enforced by
`tests/test_extraction_byte_stable.py`.

A run is "honest" when each tool's `tool_run_status` faithfully reports
`ran` / `skipped_pending_toolchain` / `skipped_pending_target_source` /
`failed`. The previous Phase 0 marker
`"phase0 extraction placeholder, anchor-only"` is no longer emitted by
this directory's contents — see `tests/test_extraction_no_anchor_only.py`.
